integrity.finite_checks: 11,422 exact-or-numerical assertions; all Prüfer trees up to eight vertices exhaustively enumerated
integrity.infinite_proof: weighted matrix-tree determinants and analytic generating-function/Rayleigh limit, not finite extrapolation

scientific_limitations: Only uniform labeled trees; third vertex must be distinct from both distance endpoints.
The degree-threshold asymptotic is for each fixed threshold; no explicit uniform finite cutoff is claimed.
Threshold three has a vanishing leading coefficient but no sign classification.
Possible earlier implicit equivalents in broad forest enumeration remain a historical-priority risk.
title: A threshold-dependent distance–degree inversion at a third vertex in uniform Cayley trees
